climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: The southernmost district of the Paso Robles AVA, ringing the town of Santa Margarita against the Santa Lucia Mountains and set apart from the other ten districts. Syrah has played a pivotal role, with Cabernet Sauvignon, Zinfandel, Merlot, Pinot Noir and Chardonnay also grown.
